picks.name: Carlos Niño & Friends feat. Saul Williams
picks.source_note: Already in your library (previously seeded via "Bubble Bath for Giants" in August) -- a different, standalone collaborative release, not a duplicate. Follows the pair's December 2024 live meeting in an LA park. Exact Bandcamp track-page link unconfirmable via search, so the purchase link points to his confirmed-live Bandcamp root.
picks.bio: "Elysian Invocation / Pollen on the Earth" (February 6, 2026, Leaving Records) is a standalone two-track EP pairing LA scene-builder Carlos Niño with poet/musician Saul Williams -- two roughly 15-minute longform pieces recorded after the pair's first proper collaboration in a forested LA park in December 2024.
picks.why_listen: A patient, spoken-word-led meditation piece -- good for an ambient interlude or a set's quieter opening stretch, away from club rhythm entirely.
